goal: Two stable drawing APIs over one SW2018 runtime core; no per-dimension runner proliferation.

responsibilities: attach to existing SolidWorks or start a controlled instance
never require all of SolidWorks to be closed
hold only when the exact target source drawing is already open

rights: place dimensions from controlled Drawing Spec/Product Definition
create datum tags and GTol/FCF from controlled authority
create notes and semantic annotation names
save only candidate output unless a separate promotion transaction is executed
prohibited: invent tolerance, fit, datum scheme, surface texture, thread class or inspection acceptance
directly promote candidate to canonical drawing
rebuild a validated native section without explicit authorization
drawing_build_api.implementation: Stable facade over registered build adapters. Existing K01 Drawing System engines remain adapters; they are not duplicated.

drawing_refine_api.purpose: Controlled refinement of an existing SLDDRW.
rights: resolve annotations by semantic ID or exact unique signature
clear unsupported drawing tolerance while preserving nominal
preserve existing view layout and validated native section
prohibited: round nominal values because they look unusual
infer thread depth from B-rep span
mutate 3D model from a drawing-refinement job
create/delete views unless the job explicitly authorizes a view operation
drawing_refine_api.preflight: Resolve every mutation target uniquely before first mutation; ambiguity means zero mutation and HOLD.

active_d003.strategy: Refine existing drawing; do not rebuild from zero.
known_cleanup: hide duplicate section Ø12 ±0.2 while preserving J2 Ø12 H9
preserve already-present M12×1-6H; do not add duplicate or DEPTH 6

anti_loop.rule: No new per-characteristic API runner. New drawing operations must be implemented as a BUILD adapter capability or REFINE job operation.
anti_loop.stop_condition: Two consecutive API actions that do not reduce the active drawing Definition of Done -> stop and reassess.

implementation_conformance.d003_proof_v1: R01-R09 only; selected precision normalization deferred until unique semantic targets are proven
